phases_and_microstructures.name: solid solution with well-defined grains, boundaries and phases

evidence.quote: the microstructure is a good solid solution with well-defined grains, boundaries, and phases.
Also, as the temperatures rise, the darker phases become rich in BCC structure, showing significant grain coarsening in Figs. 3(a) and 4(a).
The dendrites network structures show that the coefficient of atomic diffusion is pronounced when more of the grain boundaries migrate from FCC- into BCC-like structures.

The SEM-EDS of Ti 20V20Al20Fe20Cr20 equiatomic high-entropy alloys show the existence of a nano-net-like spinodal structure at the optimum temperature of 1100 °C, which are rich in body centered cubic structure.
The developed FCC and BCC phases in the interdendrite are transformed completely at the optimum temperature of 1100 °C
